description: Help organizations join the platform and list their leftover materials. Covers signing up, adding materials, managing stock, and keeping quantities accurate.
outcome: A verified organization can sign up, list surplus materials, and easily see what is available, reserved, or delivered.

description: Check the condition and quality of listed materials before buyers see them. Certified inspectors review each item so only good-quality materials are shared.
outcome: Buyers only see materials that have passed quality checks, with clear photos and condition notes.

description: Help buyers quickly find the materials they need using simple search, category filters, distance, and project requirements.
outcome: Buyers can search by keyword or nearby location and instantly find matching, verified materials.

description: Handle requests, reservations, and delivery tracking. Covers supplier approval, transport updates, delivery confirmation, and fixing quantity mismatches.
outcome: Buyers can request items, suppliers can approve holds, and both sides can track deliveries from pickup to drop-off.

description: Give managers clear reports on saved materials, avoided waste, user accounts, and platform activity.
outcome: Managers can see how much waste was prevented, view environmental savings, and manage member accounts.
